This misc. appeal under Section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicle Act, 1988 is preferred for enhancement of Rs.3,00,000/- compensation challenging the award dated 31.10.2019 passed in MACC No.139/2018 by IIIrd Additional Motor Accident Tribunal, West Nimad, Mandleshwar.

sentences.text: 2. Only quantum issue is necessary details is being mentioned.

Tribunal awarded a total compensation of Rs.5,82,000/- for the death of Subhash aged 25 years working as driver (profession has been disputed by the respondent as no document has been filed on record).

Tribunal awarded total compensation of Rs.5,82,000/- in the following heads:-
Income taken Rs.5,000 + 2,000 (40% Future Prospects) = Rs.7,000/- per month x 12 = Rs.84,000/- (P.A) Loss of Dependency Rs.7,56,000/-
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:6755 2 MA-758-2021 Negligency Deduction 25% (Rs.1,89,000/-) Funeral Expenses Rs.15,000/-
Total Amount Rs.5,82,000/-
3.
This appeal has been preferred on the ground that income is assessed on the lower side no amount has been awarded in the head of loss of estate.
Deceased was bachelor and parents have filed this appeal who were claimant before the Tribunal.
Accident has occurred on 27.03.2018 at Kasrawad road within the jurisdiction of Police Station Kasrawad, West Nimad.

Tribunal ought to have assessed monthly income of Rs.8,650/-, loss of consortium ought to have been awarded Rs.40,000/- to each and Rs.15,000/- ought to have been awarded in the head of loss of estate.

5.
After deducting the awarded amount (8,86,790 - 5,82,000) a total comes for enhancement of Rs.3,04,790/- compensation is made out.
The appeal is allowed.
The enhanced amount shall be disbursed as per impugned award of the Tribunal.

appeal is disposed off.
